title: ExcellentDuels
description: A lightweight duels plugin for your Minecraft server.
body: **The plugin is in its MVP stage.** ExcellentDuels (Exduels) is a lightweight and modular plugin which allows you to create your own practice server. In the plugin not every feature is built-in but rather you need to use an addon (e.g Parties support for ExcellentDuels **[_COMING SOON_]**) this is beacuse to keep the plugin lightweight and not packed with features that some people don't need. **📚 Features** - The basic 1v1 function. The plugin allows you to create quick 1v1 duels and fight your enemies! - Unlimited arena suport. The plugins enables to create any number of arenas with any number of spawnpoint. - Unlimited kit support. We allow you to create an infinite amount of kits with infinite possiblities. - Fully customizable configuration. You can customize every message, title, delays to make the plugin fit your server! - Minimessage support. The plugin uses the very popular MiniMessage format so you can use advanced features of well MiniMessage (e.g. Clickable Commands, Hover Text). - PlaceholderAPI support. Basic but working PaceholderAPI support so you can use placeholders in the messages of the plugin and the plugin also adds Placeholder Expansion so you can use our placeholders in scoreboards and tab plugins. - CombatLogX compatibility. If a player is in a duels players can't tag each other. - Extensive API **[BETA]**. We provide you with an API so you can add your own features and add compatiblity to other plugins without needing to fork the project! - Open Source project! It allows you to add you feature into the plugin and help me fix bugs or create issues that I can fix! It also allows you to clone the project and create your own version. **WARNING: The License is under GNU General Public License v3.0.** - Duel start and end commands. You can execute commands before duels and after duels. **📦 Addons **(Coming soon!) - Parties support - Adds support for Parties a popular party manager plugin! - FAWE for ExDuels - Allows the arenas to be regenerated when a duel ends. - And more are coming soon! **❗ Incompatiblities** - Spigot/Bukkit **(NOT PAPER OR ITS FORK)** - The plugin requires the Paper API so you must run it on Paper / Purpur or Pufferfish. - < 1.21 versions - I haven’t tested this on older versions—only on 1.21. Use it on older versions at your own risk. - If any more comes up it will be added here! **👨‍💻 Commands & Permissions** - It can be found on our Github page! Please use GitHub Issues to submit feature requests, bug reports, or any feedback about the plugin. I really appreciate it ❤️
